reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [The spirit of death arose and] it moved it and [roused] they that are in the [worlds] of the earth of darkness [. This was the] first part.

Yet, after a long time, as there was not [any boundary remaining], it gushed and streamed up [from the deep:] the five elements of death that gushed [forth,] which are smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness[. In] the second time [they streamed forth,] they were sculpted [into fixed forms,] those in which death was established [within them].
The fourth part is the evil fruits [that were brought forth] in the five trees that are in the five worlds of the land of darkness.

The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures that exist in the five worlds; the ones that were formed and generated from the five fruits of death. They are the five worlds of flesh, the five creations of darkness in which death has been established. It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female [parts].

Now, like the land of darkness, in that its spirit and its [matter] they nourished the five elements [of death]; this is also [how] the ten parts that are in male and female, the fire and lust of the flesh [conjoined] them, as they yoke them with one another [; and] they were established against the First Man. This is [the condemnation] of the darkness, it was condemned for ever.

Alongside the mystery of these twelve parts that came about in the darkness [and were arrayed] against the First Man. The twelve [parts are] the twelve spirits of error that came about from the twelve signs of the zodiac [in their likeness, yet are their perversion].
